package http

import (
	stdhttp "net/http"

	apiv1 "github.com/bemulima/ms-go-learning-planner/internal/transport/http/api/v1"
	apihandlers "github.com/bemulima/ms-go-learning-planner/internal/transport/http/api/v1/handlers"
	privatehttp "github.com/bemulima/ms-go-learning-planner/internal/transport/http/private"
	privatehandlers "github.com/bemulima/ms-go-learning-planner/internal/transport/http/private/handlers"
	"github.com/go-chi/chi/v5"
)

type RouterDependencies struct {
	CoursePlans                   apihandlers.CoursePlanHandler
	TeacherCoursePlans            privatehandlers.CoursePlanHandler
	Health                        privatehandlers.HealthHandler
	TargetCatalog                 privatehandlers.TargetCatalogHandler
	PracticeLearning              privatehandlers.PracticeLearningHandler
	LearningReadiness             privatehandlers.LearningReadinessHandler
	OnboardingPlanHandoff         privatehandlers.OnboardingPlanHandoffHandler
	InternalToken                 string
	TeacherToken                  string
	TeacherOnboardingHandoffToken string
	PracticeToken                 string
	DiagnosticBootstrap           apihandlers.DiagnosticAssessmentBootstrapHandler
	DiagnosticPlans               privatehandlers.DiagnosticAssessmentPlanHandler
	DiagnosticPlacement           privatehandlers.DiagnosticPlacementHandler
	ProjectAuthoring              privatehandlers.ProjectAuthoringHandler
}

func NewRouter(dependencies RouterDependencies) stdhttp.Handler {
	router := chi.NewRouter()
	router.Mount("/api/learning-planner/v1", apiv1.NewRouter(dependencies.CoursePlans, dependencies.DiagnosticBootstrap))
	if dependencies.InternalToken != "" || dependencies.TeacherToken != "" || dependencies.TeacherOnboardingHandoffToken != "" || dependencies.PracticeToken != "" {
		router.Mount("/internal", privatehttp.NewRouter(
			dependencies.Health, dependencies.TeacherCoursePlans, dependencies.TargetCatalog,
			dependencies.PracticeLearning, dependencies.LearningReadiness, dependencies.OnboardingPlanHandoff,
			dependencies.DiagnosticPlans, dependencies.DiagnosticPlacement, dependencies.ProjectAuthoring,
			dependencies.InternalToken, dependencies.TeacherToken,
			dependencies.TeacherOnboardingHandoffToken,
			dependencies.PracticeToken,
		))
	}
	return router
}
